title: Spinal Cord Stimulators for Chronic Pain
scope: Percutaneous SCS trial prior to permanent implantation

sourceSpan.quote: The implantation of spinal cord stimulators (SCS) may be covered as therapies for the relief of chronic intractable pain.

present: {date}: Chronic intractable neuropathic leg pain for 2 years following lumbar laminectomy (failed back surgery syndrome).
contradicted: {date}: Acute low back strain of 10 days duration.

children.text: More conservative therapies (medications, physical therapy, psychological therapy or other modalities) tried first

sourceSpan.quote: SCS therapy should be considered as a late option after more conservative attempts such as medications, physical therapy, psychological therapy or other modalities have been tried.

present: {date}: Prior treatments: gabapentin and duloxetine, 12 weeks of PT, cognitive behavioral therapy and two epidural injections, all without durable relief.
negated: {date}: No prior pain treatments have been tried.
paraphrased: {date}: Has exhausted medication trials, therapy and pain psychology without adequate control.

children.text: Careful screening, evaluation and diagnosis by a multidisciplinary team prior to implantation

sourceSpan.quote: Patients must have undergone careful screening, evaluation and diagnosis by a multidisciplinary team prior to implantation.

present: {date}: Reviewed at multidisciplinary spine/pain conference (pain medicine, neurosurgery, psychology): appropriate SCS trial candidate.
negated: {date}: No multidisciplinary review has taken place.

children.suggestedFix: Attach the psychological evaluation clearing the patient for a neurostimulator trial.

present: {date}: Psychological evaluation completed; no contraindications to neuromodulation identified. Cleared for SCS trial.
negated: {date}: Psychology referral placed; evaluation not yet completed.

sourceSpan.quote: Must not have active substance abuse issues.

present: {date}: No history of substance use disorder; urine drug screen consistent with prescribed medications only.
contradicted: {date}: Active alcohol use disorder, currently drinking daily.

children.text: Patient education and discussion of risks and benefits documented

sourceSpan.quote: Must undergo proper patient education, discussion, and disclosure including an extensive discussion of the risks and benefits of this therapy.

present: {date}: Extensive discussion of SCS trial risks (infection, lead migration, bleeding) and benefits; patient verbalized understanding.
